title: The Result Day
en: The day of results arrived. Lin Chen's hands **trembled**（颤抖） as he typed his **identification**（身份） number into the **website**（网站）. The **screen**（屏幕） **froze**（冻结） for a moment — the longest moment of his life. Then the numbers appeared. 658 out of 750. He stared at the **digits**（数字）, unable to **process**（处理） what he was seeing. His mother asked "How did you do?" He turned to her, tears streaming down his face. "I did it," he **whispered**（低语）. "I really did it." She **burst**（突然爆发） into tears of joy and **embraced**（拥抱） him tightly. His father, usually **reserved**（内敛的）, **pumped**（挥舞） his fist in the air. "That's my son!"
cn: 成绩公布的日子到了。林辰的手颤抖着将身份证号码输入网站。屏幕冻结了一瞬间——他一生中最长的一瞬间。然后数字出现了。750分中的658分。他盯着这些数字，无法处理他看到的。他妈妈问'你考得怎么样？'他转向她，泪水流下脸庞。'我做到了，'他低语道。'我真的做到了。'她突然爆发出喜悦的泪水，紧紧拥抱着他。他父亲，通常内敛，在空中挥拳。'那是我的儿子！'

title: Choosing a Path
en: Now came another challenge: choosing a **university**（大学） and **major**（专业）. Lin Chen had been **accepted**（录取） by several schools. His parents wanted him to stay **local**（本地的）, but his **ambition**（雄心） pulled him toward a **prestigious**（有声望的） university in Beijing. "It's your decision," his father said. "We'll **support**（支持） whatever you choose." Liu Wei was going to Shanghai to study **medicine**（医学）. Zhang Tao would stay in the **province**（省份） to study **accounting**（会计学）. They were all heading in different **directions**（方向）. The thought was **painful**（痛苦的） but also **exciting**（令人兴奋的）. The world was opening up before them.
cn: 现在来了另一个挑战：选择大学和专业。林辰被几所学校录取了。他父母想让他留在本地，但他的雄心把他拉向北京一所声望很高的大学。'这是你的决定，'他父亲说。'无论你选什么，我们都会支持。'刘薇要去上海学医学。张涛会留在本省学会计。他们都在走向不同的方向。这个想法是痛苦的但也是令人兴奋的。世界正在他们面前展开。

title: The Farewell Party
en: Before everyone **scattered**（分散） to different cities, they held a **farewell**（告别的） party at Zhang Tao's house. His parents had **generously**（慷慨地） **prepared**（准备） a feast. They ate, sang, and **reminisced**（回忆） about their high school years — the exams, the sports meets, the late-night study sessions, the **dumb**（愚蠢的） jokes. Someone brought a **camera**（相机） and they took countless **photographs**（照片）. "Promise we'll meet again every year," Liu Wei said. They all raised their glasses. "To **friendship**（友谊）!" they **chorused**（齐声说）. Lin Chen looked around at the faces of the people who had become his second family. He knew that no matter how far apart they **drifted**（漂流）, these bonds would last.
cn: 在大家分散到不同城市之前，他们在张涛家举办了一场告别派对。张涛的父母慷慨准备了一场盛宴。他们吃、唱、回忆高中岁月——考试、运动会、深夜学习、愚蠢的笑话。有人带了相机，他们拍了无数照片。'答应我们每年都见面，'刘薇说。他们都举起杯子。'为友谊！'他们齐声说。林辰环顾着这些已成为他第二家人的面孔。他知道无论他们漂流多远，这些纽带都会持久。

title: The Train
en: The morning of his **departure**（离开）, Lin Chen stood on the **platform**（站台） of the train station. His mother had packed him enough food to last a week — **dumplings**（饺子）, **pickles**（泡菜）, and homemade **cookies**（饼干）. His father handed him an **envelope**（信封）. "Open it on the train," he said. The **whistle**（汽笛） blew. Lin Chen hugged his parents one last time and **boarded**（登上） the train. As the **landscape**（风景） began to slide past the window, he opened the envelope. Inside was a letter in his father's **handwriting**（笔迹）: "Son, I never finished middle school. I spent my life in a kitchen, dreaming of a better future for you. Today, you have made that dream come true. Go **forward**（向前） with courage. We love you." Lin Chen pressed the letter to his chest and watched the mountains roll by.
cn: 离开的早晨，林辰站在火车站的站台上。他妈妈给他打包了足够吃一周的食物——饺子、泡菜和自制饼干。他父亲递给他一个信封。'在火车上打开，'他说。汽笛响了。林辰最后一次拥抱了父母，登上了火车。当风景开始滑过窗户时，他打开了信封。里面是他父亲笔迹的一封信：'儿子，我从未读完初中。我一生在厨房里度过，梦想着给你一个更好的未来。今天，你实现了那个梦想。带着勇气向前走。我们爱你。'林辰把信按在胸前，看着山峦滚过。

title: The Roommate
en: Lin Chen's **roommate**（室友） was a tall, **skinny**（瘦的） boy from Guangdong named Chen Hao. He spoke with a heavy **accent**（口音） and had a **contagious**（有感染力的） laugh. Their dormitory was **tiny**（微小的） but **cozy**（舒适的） — two beds, two desks, and a **balcony**（阳台） overlooking the campus. "I've never been this far north before," Chen Hao said, shivering in his **sweater**（毛衣）. "The **climate**（气候） here is so different!" They spent the first evening **unpacking**（打开行李） and **decorating**（装饰） their room with posters and photos. By midnight, they had become friends. "We're going to have a great four years," Chen Hao said. Lin Chen smiled. "I think so too."
cn: 林辰的室友是一个来自广东的高瘦男孩，叫陈浩。他说话带着浓重的口音，笑声有感染力。他们的宿舍微小但舒适——两张床、两张书桌、一个俯瞰校园的阳台。'我从未到过这么北的地方，'陈浩说，在他的毛衣里发抖。'这里的气候太不同了！'他们第一个晚上花在了打开行李和用海报和照片装饰房间上。到午夜时，他们已经成为朋友。'我们将会有精彩的四年，'陈浩说。林辰微笑了。'我也这么认为。'

title: Orientation
en: Freshman **orientation**（迎新） week was a **whirlwind**（旋风） of activities. There were campus **tours**（参观）, **ice-breaking**（破冰的） games, and **lectures**（讲座） about university life. Lin Chen learned where the **cafeteria**（食堂） was, how to use the library **database**（数据库）, and which **professors**（教授） had a **reputation**（名声） for being strict. He signed up for several **clubs**（社团） — the **engineering**（工程学） society, the **photography**（摄影） club, and a **volunteer**（志愿者） group. "Don't spread yourself too thin," an **advisor**（顾问） warned. But Lin Chen wanted to **experience**（体验） everything. He felt like a **sponge**（海绵） ready to **absorb**（吸收） everything university had to offer.
cn: 新生迎新周是一场活动的旋风。有校园参观、破冰游戏和关于大学生活的讲座。林辰知道了食堂在哪里、如何使用图书馆数据库、哪些教授以严格著称。他报名参加了几个社团——工程学社、摄影俱乐部和志愿者小组。'别把自己摊得太薄，'一位顾问警告道。但林辰想体验一切。他感觉自己像一块海绵，准备好了吸收大学提供的所有。

title: The First Lecture
en: The first **lecture**（讲座） of Lin Chen's university career was "Introduction to **Civil**（土木的） Engineering." The professor, Doctor Zhang, was a **veteran**（经验丰富的） in the field who had helped design the city's **subway**（地铁） system. "Engineering is not about **concrete**（混凝土） and steel," she began. "It's about solving problems for **humanity**（人类）." She showed slides of bridges in **remote**（偏远的） villages that had **transformed**（改变） communities. Lin Chen was **riveted**（被吸引住的）. This was exactly what he had dreamed of — building things that made a **difference**（不同） in people's lives. He took **furious**（疯狂的） notes, not wanting to miss a single word.
cn: 林辰大学生涯的第一场讲座是'土木工程概论'。教授张博士是一位经验丰富的专家，曾参与设计该市的地铁系统。'工程不是关于混凝土和钢铁，'她开始道。'它是关于为人类解决问题。'她展示了偏远村庄里改变了社区的桥梁幻灯片。林辰被深深吸引住了。这正是他梦想的——建造改变人们生活的东西。他疯狂地记笔记，不想漏掉一个字。

title: The Laboratory
en: The engineering **laboratory**（实验室） was a **wonderland**（奇境） of machines and **gadgets**（小装置）. Rows of computers ran **simulations**（模拟） of bridge **stress**（应力） tests. 3D **printers**（打印机） hummed as they created models. A **robot**（机器人） arm moved with **precision**（精确）. Lin Chen felt like a child in a toy store. His first **assignment**（作业） was to design a simple bridge using **software**（软件）. It took him five hours and looked **clumsy**（笨拙的）, but when the **simulation**（模拟） showed it could hold weight, he felt a **thrill**（激动） of accomplishment. "Not bad for a first try," his **tutor**（导师） said. "You have a natural **intuition**（直觉） for this."
cn: 工程实验室是一个机器和小装置的奇境。成排的计算机运行着桥梁应力测试的模拟。3D打印机在嗡嗡声中创建模型。一个机器人手臂以精确度移动。林辰感觉像玩具店里的孩子。他的第一个作业是用软件设计一座简单的桥。这花了他五个小时，看起来很笨拙，但当模拟显示它可以承重时，他感到一阵激动。'第一次尝试不错，'他的导师说。'你对这个有天然的直觉。'

title: The Email
en: One evening, Lin Chen received an email from Liu Wei. She wrote about her life in Shanghai — the **lectures**（讲座）, the **dissections**（解剖） in anatomy class, the **pressure**（压力） of **memorizing**（记忆） hundreds of medical terms. "Sometimes I wonder if I chose the right path," she wrote. "But then I think about the patients I might help someday. That keeps me going." She asked about his life in Beijing. Lin Chen wrote back immediately, describing everything — his classes, his roommate, the **magnificent**（宏伟的） campus. At the end, he added: "I miss our study sessions. No one here **challenges**（挑战） me the way you did." He hit **send**（发送） and felt a little less **homesick**（想家的）.
cn: 一天晚上，林辰收到了一封刘薇的邮件。她写了她在上海的生活——讲座、解剖学课的解剖、记忆数百个医学术语的压力。'有时候我想知道我是否选择了正确的道路，'她写道。'但然后我想到了我将来可能帮助的病人。那让我坚持下去。'她问了他在北京的生活。林辰立刻回信，描述了所有——他的课程、室友、宏伟的校园。最后，他补充道：'我想念我们的学习时光。这里没有人像你这样挑战我。'他点击发送，感觉不那么想家了。

title: The Winter
en: Beijing's winter was **brutal**（残酷的）. The temperature **dropped**（下降） below zero, and a **fierce**（猛烈的） wind swept across the campus. Lin Chen had never experienced cold like this. He bought a thick **overcoat**（大衣）, a **scarf**（围巾）, and **insulated**（保暖的） boots. The lake on campus **froze**（冻结） solid, and students went **skating**（滑冰） on it. Piles of **snow**（雪） lined the pathways. Chen Hao, who was from the south, was **miserable**（痛苦的）. "How do people live like this?" he complained. But Lin Chen found a strange beauty in the **bleak**（萧瑟的） landscape — the bare trees, the gray sky, the **quiet**（安静） that came with snowfall. It was so different from his hometown. He loved it.
cn: 北京的冬天很残酷。气温降到零度以下，一阵猛烈的风席卷校园。林辰从未经历过这样的寒冷。他买了厚大衣、围巾和保暖靴。校园里的湖冻得结实，学生们在上面滑冰。成堆的雪排列在路边。来自南方的陈浩很痛苦。'人们怎么这样生活？'他抱怨道。但林辰发现了一种奇异的美——光秃的树、灰色的天空、下雪时的安静。这和他的家乡太不同了。他爱它。
